entities.name: Seven-storied stone pagoda in Tappyeong-ri
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Seven-story Stone Pagoda in Tappyeong-ri, Chungju, also called the Jungang Pagoda, is a 14.5-meter-tall (48 ft) stone pagoda near the Namhan River in North Chungcheong Province, South Korea. It is the tallest stone pagoda of the Later Silla period.
